compartment.title: Finalized VPS deployment, started enrichment, verified subcommands
compartment.p1: Restarted the Hermes gateway on the VPS after deploying the tdg-rust binary. Verified binary installation and started the graph enrichment process on production data. Then checked available CLI subcommands to confirm the build was complete and functional.
compartment.p2: Restarted Hermes gateway on VPS, verified binary deployment, started production enrichment, and confirmed available CLI subcommands.
compartment.p3: Verified VPS deployment, initiated production enrichment, confirmed CLI completeness.
